people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
translations.bsb: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another against Judah into fortified Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
translations.asv: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
